project_type: TanStack Start (Nitro/H3) backend + Expo SDK 57 React Native mobile app with TypeScript
build_system: pnpm workspaces. Backend: Vite 8.x with TanStack Start. Mobile: Expo CLI with metro bundler. Backend uses prisma for DB code generation.
test_framework: No test framework currently configured in either project
build_command: Backend: cd patulod-admin && pnpm db:push && pnpm db:generate (for DB changes). Mobile: No explicit build step needed for dev.
test_command: Mobile: pnpm typecheck in patulod-mobile. Backend: No test command configured.
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm db:push && pnpm db:generate in patulod-admin after schema changes. 2. Run pnpm typecheck in patulod-mobile to verify TypeScript. 3. Test API endpoints manually using the mobile app or API client. 4. Verify file uploads end-to-end.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/generated/client/ is generated by prisma generate and should NOT be checked into git. It's already in .gitignore. Generated after every schema change via pnpm db:generate.
environment_constraints: Backend runs on http://192.168.100.4:3000. Mobile connects to this IP. Supabase env vars (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY) are NOT currently in .env.local - storage implementation must have a local fallback. expo-image-picker is NOT in package.json and MUST be added (compatible with Expo SDK 57).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found in repo. Follow existing patterns: error handling with try/catch, validation before processing, audit logs for user actions, Better Auth for sessions with token-based mobile auth.
key_patterns: Mobile: expo-router file-based routing, panelui-native UI components, lucide-react-native icons, expo-secure-store for tokens, TanStack Query for data fetching. Backend: TanStack Start file-based API routes, createFileRoute with server.handlers object, Prisma with PrismaPg adapter, Better Auth with session tokens, libphonenumber-js for phone validation. Auth: Bearer token in Authorization header (pattern exists in api.ts but not yet used in any backend routes - we'll establish it). Request parsing: request.json() for JSON, request.formData() for multipart (Web API standard).
directory_structure: Root: patulod/ (monorepo). Backend: patulod-admin/ (TanStack Start app with src/routes/ for file-based routing, src/lib/ for utilities, prisma/ for schema and generated client). Mobile: patulod-mobile/ (Expo app with app/ for expo-router screens, lib/ for utilities, components/ for reusable components). Artifacts: patulod-admin/.agents/tasks/ for planning artifacts (never checked into git).
